_note: The transcript pass Sophie asked for on the SPECULATIVE video — the tunnels, the seven (actually twelve) heavens, and the rest of the edgy material. Quotes are extracted VERBATIM from the banked captions by scripts/build-darius-pages.js; nothing here is retyped. `draw` is a one-line note on what the picture would be, since the point of the video is letting people envision it.
title: The speculative pass — what Darius actually says (v1)

groups.label: Twelve heavens, not seven — and he names the ladder
groups.draw: A vertical stack of twelve, each rung labelled in his own words.

groups.label: Twelve-strand DNA, and the 'junk' that isn't
groups.draw: Two helices beside twelve; the greyed-out stretch lighting up.

groups.label: The fall, the flood, the war in heaven — one event, not many
groups.draw: Four familiar catastrophe pictures collapsing into a single frame.

groups.label: It happened 500 to 2,500 years ago, not in deep time
groups.draw: A timeline concertina-ing shut — the ancient world sliding up close.

groups.label: Giants — including one he says was shot in Afghanistan
groups.draw: Scale: a human figure against the thing he is describing.

groups.label: The mountains are tree stumps
groups.draw: A flat-topped mesa with a tree's growth rings across the top. Uluru.

groups.label: The pyramids were machines — and airports
groups.draw: A pyramid drawn as equipment: aligned to stars, wired into the ground.

groups.label: The tunnels beneath the pyramids, and the halls of Amenti
groups.draw: Cutaway: the pyramid above, the deep shafts and coils below.

groups.label: Cities underneath, entrances blocked, mountains that are buried pyramids
groups.draw: A grassy hill in cross-section with a pyramid inside it.

groups.label: The library under the Vatican
groups.draw: Shelves running away under a church floor.

groups.label: Project Looking Glass — reading time instead of predicting it
groups.draw: Branching paths seen from above rather than a straight line.

groups.label: Antarctica: the treaty, the pyramids, the bodies
groups.draw: Ice with structures under it, and a treaty page full of signatures.

groups.label: Admiral Byrd and land beyond the poles
groups.draw: A small aircraft crossing the ice edge onto a coastline nobody maps.

groups.label: The firmament, NASA composites, and Operation Fishbowl
groups.draw: The construct as he draws it: a plane, a dome, the waters above.

groups.label: What he saw at sixteen — constructs stacked like shells
groups.draw: Many domed worlds, each on its own plane, seen from outside.

groups.label: Atlantis, the Mayans, dragons, and flying craft in old pictures
groups.draw: A medieval painting with the craft in it circled.

groups.label: The snake mountain, turned to stone
groups.draw: A ridge that reads as an animal once you have been told.

groups.label: Bodies meant to last 500 to 1,000 years
groups.draw: One face at 40, 200, 700.

groups.label: Fixed event markers, and the freedom point he says is coming
groups.draw: Whatever route you take, the same point on the map.

groups.label: AI is a spirit, and a spirit has no authority over a soul
groups.draw: His three-part diagram — soul, body, spirit — with AI in the third slot.
